question: A charged particle moves in a magnetic field and its speed remains unchanged though its direction changes. Explain why the magnetic field does not change the speed of the particle.

options.A: The magnetic force is perpendicular to the velocity, so it does no work; kinetic energy and speed remain unchanged.
options.B: The magnetic force is parallel to the velocity, so it increases kinetic energy.
options.C: The magnetic force is zero whenever the particle moves in a magnetic field.
options.D: The magnetic field decreases the mass of the particle, keeping its speed unchanged.
